newsitem.title: USA: NYC says increases tax-exempt deal to $808 mln.
newsitem.headline: NYC says increases tax-exempt deal to $808 mln.

text.p: New York City Tuesday increased the size of its planned tax-exempt bond sale on Wednesday to $808 million from $550 million, Alan Anders, the city's director of finance policy, said.
"Basically the economic numbers did not come in higher than expected this morning and the market's having a bit of a rally," Anders said, explaining why the size of the deal was increased.
Anders said the move will not affect the size of a separate $300 Eurobond deal, also set for pricing Wednesday.
Goldman Sachs & Co is the senior manager for the city offerings.
